items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Bud Powell in a list of musicians; Interviewee responds with a general opinion on the 'new music' style associated with them, stating 'All of it sounded like scrambled eggs to me!', indicating no personal interaction or specific relationship.

ctx.x: Okay. But what did you did think of the new music as a style, just in general? What did you think of this music that Charlie Parker was playing, and Dizzy Gillespie, and Bud Powell?

Well, to me, I didn't... I couldn't get it under my finger just what it was. But it was music, but it was a different style. I always recognized a tune, you might play a little melody once in a while. But if you didn't know what number that was playing, you wouldn't... You know. All of it sounded like scrambled eggs to me! Heh-heh.
